info.description: API-first contract. See contract README for bounds, authority, retries and interpretation; no native platform adapter is implied.

get.description: Company and every nested resource are scoped before use; see the network contract.

parameters.description: Required for a user session; selects a company for live authorization. A store key derives company/store from the key; conflicting supplied scope is rejected.

post.description: Company and every nested resource are scoped before use; see the network contract. Requires original idempotency key/time. Exact competing retries have one committed effect; changed payload/time conflicts. Expired original requests return 410.

post.description: Store-key-only. Company/store derive exclusively from the credential. Caller company/user/store fields are forbidden. An exact replay returns existing state; conflicting event/checkout identity is 409. Distinct event IDs cannot duplicate an immutable order/refund business fact. Original order_created_at must be within 24 hours and at most 30 seconds in the future, including on replay. Candidate IDs are normalized as a set; full timestamp precision is retained. No eligible candidate uses deterministic reason precedence foreign_or_missing, future, expired, bot; no consent and empty history have their own reasons.

Store-key-only. Company/store derive exclusively from the credential. Caller company/user/store fields are forbidden. An exact replay returns existing state; conflicting event/checkout identity is 409. Distinct event IDs cannot duplicate an immutable order/refund business fact.

202.description: Durably pending prerequisite reconciliation; not a paid sale

post.description: Public installation selects tenant/store; consent must be true. Event ID deduplicates only within that installation. Browser observations never create a paid order. Exact approved-origin CORS is not authentication. Original observed_at must be within the 24-hour retry horizon and at most 30 seconds in the future; event uniqueness is retained at least 48 hours. visible_placement declares at least 50 percent intersection for 1000 continuous milliseconds while the document is visible (observation version 1); this is not verified viewability.

get.description: Commit a distinct click for each GET before issuing a no-store redirect. Merge reserved ob_click parameter with a URL parser. On commit failure/uncertainty return retryable 503 without Location. Revalidate tenant/domain/link at redirect.

head.description: Checks availability without creating a click or emitting a tracked redirect.

get.description: Requires consent and one scoped click/link. With no event_id each GET counts separately. Return GIF only after durable observation, or retryable failure. No-store; use a cache-busting event ID. An observed image is not a verified ad impression. Supplying event_id requires observed_at (original RFC3339 instant, <=40 characters); keep both across retries. observed_at without event_id is rejected. Original observations older than 24 hours or more than 30 seconds in the future are rejected, including after pruning; uniqueness is retained at least 48 hours.

parameters.name: observed_at
parameters.description: Required exactly when event_id is supplied; the original observation time, unchanged on every retry.

head.summary: Validate a pixel reference without recording an observation
head.description: Uses the same scoped reference and consent checks, returns no image and never inserts an observation. This is not an observation acknowledgement.

parameters.name: observed_at
parameters.description: Required exactly when event_id is supplied; the original observation time, unchanged on every retry.

204.description: Eligible pixel reference; no observation recorded

get.description: Half-open interval at most 93 days. Click time, paid time and refund occurrence time are separate clocks. No currency addition. Conversion rate is not a cohort rate; may exceed 1, null with zero clicks, omitted for sold-product filtering. Financial aggregates are separate from click counts. Observations use observation time. Sold-product groups use matching lines; contextual clicks/observations can repeat, rates are null, whole-order/refund tax/shipping and distinct counts can overlap. Use ungrouped/unfiltered totals for the overall result. Group keys and filters use frozen dimensions. Aggregate overflow rejects with 400. Query deadline 2 seconds.

get.description: Same scope, filters, grouping and clocks as analytics. No limit or cursor accepted. At most 10,000 data rows across groups/currencies, 2-second query deadline, safe CSV formula escaping; reject rather than truncate. Group click/order/rate fields occur once on its first currency row; blank on subsequent rows. Sold-product group counts and tax/shipping can overlap and must not be added to overall totals. Currency metric columns are prefixed currency_ and have unique names, distinct from group metrics. Each row carries group_by, click_observation_basis, financial_basis and nonadditive_measures labels; purchased-product group exports explicitly forbid summing contextual clicks/observations and overlapping order/refund counts/tax/shipping.
